title: Data-flow rules that know a parameter's mode
summary: Two OFF out-argument rules; since 1.52 a local passed by value to a method before assignment reports under the default used-before-assignment
intro: Read this to see what write-only-local, overwrite-before-read and used-before-assignment cannot see, the two OFF rules that report the out shapes, and the by-value arm folded into used-before-assignment in 1.52.
